fields.name: eventId
fields.description: Composite <sensor>:<upstreamId> identity for MAP-stage rejections; empty string for PARSE-stage, where no DTO existed

fields.name: stage
fields.description: PARSE when the bytes never became a valid source DTO, MAP when domain validation refused a parsed value

fields.name: reasonCode
fields.description: Domain ReasonCode name: MALFORMED_JSON, MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD, INVALID_TIMESTAMP, INVALID_PORT, INVALID_COUNTER

fields.name: detail
fields.description: Human-readable reason detail; empty string when absent

fields.name: rawPayloadHash
fields.description: SHA-256 of the rejected bytes, 64 lowercase hex characters. The bytes themselves are never published

fields.name: receivedAt
fields.description: When the pipeline rejected the record, ISO-8601 UTC, stamped at the point of rejection
